title: Dvergr power

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Dvergr Power is a Status effect that increases damage from all skills by 20% for 20 seconds.
During battle, Support Dvergr mages can cast a support spell that applies Dvergr Power to all Dvergr and players in an 8-meter radius around them.
